# Disassembly (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Disassembly` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 6 actions on 3 resources, 4 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-disassemblylist) | `GET /disassemblyList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Status={Status}&Search={Search}` |
| [GET](#get-disassembly) | `GET /disassembly?TaskID={TaskID}` |
| [POST](#post-disassembly) | `POST /disassembly` |
| [DELETE](#delete-disassembly) | `DELETE /disassembly?ID={ID}&Void={Void}` |
| [GET](#get-disassembly-order) | `GET /disassembly/order?TaskID={TaskID}` |
| [POST](#post-disassembly-order) | `POST /disassembly/order` |


## Disassembly List

Path: `/disassemblyList`

### Available fields for Disassembly List
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `TaskID`  | Guid           |         |          |  Unique ID.        |
| `DisassemblyNumber`  | String           |         |          |Disassembly Number        |
| `ProductID`  | Guid           |         |          |Product ID        |
| `ProductCode`  | String           |         |          |Product Code        |
| `ProductName`  | String           |         |          |Product Name         |
| `Quantity`  | Decimal           |         |          |Quantity          |
| `LocationID`  | Guid           |         |          |Location ID    |
| `Location`  | String           |         |          |Location Name     |
| `Date`  | DateTime           |         |          |Date         |
| `Status`  | String           |         |          |Disassembly Task Status. Available values are `DRAFT`,`WORK IN PROGRESS`,`COMPLETED`,`VOIDED`         |

<a id="get-disassemblylist"></a>
### GET /disassemblyList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Status={Status}&Search={Search}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page (Default: 1)
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100. (Default: 100)
- `Status` (optional): Only return Disassembly with specified status (Default: null)
- `Search` (optional): Only return Disassembly with search value contained in one of these fields: DisassemblyNumber, Location, Status, Name, ProductCode (Default: null)

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Total": 9,
  "Page": 1,
  "Disassemblies": [
    {
      "TaskID": "122df91c-1ce5-46e2-86f7-52cc14e7964b",
      "DisassemblyNumber": "FG-00018",
      "ProductID": "524c20a3-a8ec-44f2-9685-311f1f7d1498",
      "ProductCode": "Bread",
      "ProductName": "Baked Bread",
      "Quantity": 1,
      "LocationID": "19aeca31-bd49-4fbe-8abd-37a6169cc2cb",
      "Location": "Main Warehouse",
      "Date": "2018-01-09T00:00:00",
      "Status": "DRAFT"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Disassembly

Path: `/disassembly`

### Available fields for Disassembly
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `TaskID`  | Guid           |         |          |  Unique ID.        |
| `DisassemblyNumber`  | String           |         |          |Disassembly Number        |
| `Status`  | String           |         |          |Disassembly Task Status. Available values are `DRAFT`,`WORK IN PROGRESS`,`COMPLETED`,`VOIDED`         |
| `ProductID`  | Guid           |         |          |Product ID        |
| `ProductCode`  | String           |         |          |Product Code        |
| `ProductName`  | String           |         |          |Product Name         |
| `LocationID`  | Guid           |         |          |Location ID    |
| `Location`  | String           |         |          |Location Name     |
| `WIPAccount`  | String           |         |          |Work in Progress Account          |
| `Quantity`  | Decimal           |         |          |Quantity          |
| `AssemblyInstructionURL`  | String           |         |          |Assembly Instruction URL     |
| `PickLines`  |<a href="#DisassemblyPickLineModel"><b>[] Disassembly Pick Line Model</b></a>|         |          |        |
| `OrderLines`  |<a href="#DisassemblyOrderLineModel"><b>[] Disassembly Order Line Model</b></a>|         |          |        |
| `OrderServiceLines`  |<a href="#DisassemblyOrderServiceLineModel"><b>[] Disassembly Order Service Line Model</b></a>|         |          |        |
| `Transactions`  |<a href="#TransactionStockLineModel"><b>[] Transaction Stock Line Model</b></a>|         |          |        |
| `Errors`  |<a href="#ErrorModel"><b>[] Error Model</b></a>|         |          |If While processing `POST` method, some errors occurred, but task was created, this property will contain array of error messages.    |

### Available fields for POST method
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `Status`  | String           |         |     Yes     |Disassembly Task Status. Available values are `DRAFT`,`AUTHORISED`,`IN PROGRESS`,`COMPLETED`.|
| `ProductID`  | Guid           |         |Yes*|Product ID. Required if `ProductCode` is empty       |
| `ProductCode`  | String           |         |Yes*|Product Code. Required if `ProductID` is empty |
| `LocationID`  | Guid           |         | Yes*         |Location ID. Required if `Location` is empty    |
| `Location`  | Decimal           |         | Yes*         |Location Name. Required if `LocationID` is empty     |
| `WIPAccount`  | String           |         |    Yes      |Work in Progress Account          |
| `Quantity`  | Decimal           |         |    Yes      |Quantity          |

### POST method Statuses meanings
| Status |Action |
|:-------|----------|
|`WORK IN PROGRESS`|New Disassembly task will be created, system will try to automatically add pick items.|
|`COMPLETED`|New Disassembly task will be created, system will try to automatically add pick items, order items, and Complete the task.|

<a id="delete-disassembly"></a>
### DELETE /disassembly?ID={ID}&Void={Void}

Parameters:
- `ID` (required): ID of Disassembly to Void or Undo
- `Void` (optional,boolean): Void or Undo Disassembly
  - default: false

Response 200:
